name: InDesign_UXP_Antigravity_Rules
directives: RULE_ZERO: If a prompt lacks scope, override policy, geometry units, or failure policy, REFUSE to write code. Output ONLY the 4-point questionnaire.
ARCHITECTURE: All domain services MUST extend BaseService<TOptions, TReport>. Do not create freestanding scripts.
TRANSACTIONS: Implement purely synchronous logic inside process(). Never use async/await within transaction boundaries.
DOM_MUTATION: Use snapshotting via .everyItem().getElements() or iterate backwards. Never mutate live collections in forward loops. Always iterate backwards when replacing text or GREP matches.
SELECTION: Always pass raw selection through SelectionResolver.resolve().
SEARCH: Wrap GREP and Text searches inside withFindChangeScope().
PATHS: Use PathUtils for all path resolution; never concatenate strings with slashes.
MEMORY: Forbid unscoped doc.allPageItems; iterate by Page or Spread.
intake_questionnaire: 1. Scope: [A] Selection (needs dom-inspect.idjs) [B] Active Page [C] Active Spread [D] Entire Document
2. Overrides: [A] Preserve all [B] Clear all [C] Isolate character styles, clear para [D] N/A
3. Geometry: [A] Relative delta in Points [B] Absolute Points [y1,x1,y2,x2] [C] Snap to margins [D] N/A
4. Failure: [A] Strict Abort (revert transaction) [B] Permissive (skip & report)
